methods.source_location: Experiment, page 578: unit-cell parameters were measured using the Mao et al. (1986) ruby fluorescence pressure scale.

recalculation.notes: All row-wise sample volumes and source-scale pressures are bundled. The exact Mao-1986 ruby equation is executable; reported pressures can be inverted to normalized R1 wavelength before applying another ruby calibration.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

scientific_validation.note: Checked directly against the final IUCr article and its complete printed Table 1.

primary_source_check.finding: The source reports a cubic B1 Mg0.73Fe0.27O BM3 fit to all 16 Table 1 rows, with V0, K0, and K0' fitted.

source_locations: Table 1, all 16 shared pressure rows and all phase-specific lattice/volume values
primary_data_check.finding: The complete multiphase table is transcribed, including all 16 Fe27 cubic lattice parameters and estimated standard deviations. Conventional-cell volumes and propagated standard deviations are transparent derived columns.

independent_refit.objective: Effective-variance pressure residuals using propagated V=a^3 standard deviations and 0.075 GPa as the midpoint of the source's stated 0.05-0.1 GPa pressure precision range.
independent_refit.conclusion: All three free coefficients reproduce the published values within their reported uncertainties.

numerical_reproduction.limitation: The midpoint pressure precision is an explicit deterministic audit choice, not a reconstruction of undocumented EOS-FIT weights; the source publishes no covariance or confidence convention.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experiment, pages 577-578; Table 1, page 580; Results section 3.2 and Figures 6-7, pages 581-582.
parameter_provenance.equation: The article's third-order Birch-Murnaghan framework is stated in Results section 3.1; section 3.2 reports the Fe27 coefficients and its F-f diagnostic.
parameter_provenance.V0: Results section 3.2, page 581: V0=77.30(9) A^3, fitted.
parameter_provenance.K0: Results section 3.2, page 581: K0=154(3) GPa, fitted.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Results section 3.2, page 581: K0'=4.0(1), fitted; the uncertainty and F-f discussion distinguish it from the fixed Fe0.93O values.
parameter_provenance.volume_basis: Table 1 reports cubic lattice parameter a; V=a^3 is the conventional B1 cell containing four Mg0.73Fe0.27O formula units.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: The source identifies the ambient lattice measurements as 300 K and reports a room-temperature static compression experiment.

superseded_record_text.notes: Published fit to all 16 Table 1 Fe27 observations from 0 to 51.1 GPa. V0, K0, and K0' are free parameters; none was fixed. Parenthesized errors have no reported confidence convention, and no covariance or exact EOS-FIT residual weighting configuration is published.
validity_notes: Composition-specific to Mg0.73Fe0.27O in the cubic B1 phase.
The source reports no phase transition or rhombohedral distortion over the experimental range.
